evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A social agent's most basic decisions (should I react to this post? who should I reach out to?) are not purely content problems.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: With Gemini-3-Flash on a stratified subset of n = 150 queries per task, ReAdapt improves warm-introduction accuracy from 37% to 51% (+14 points) and reaction-selection accuracy from 69% to 77% (+8 points).
